summary.text: Pamela Swift is the Democratic candidate for the Maine House of Representatives, District 62, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Republican Katrina Smith.
A farmer and former OB/GYN from Palermo, she previously ran for the seat in 2022 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: Swift earned a bachelor's degree from Virginia Tech in 1984 and an M.D. from the Medical College of Virginia in 1988.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, she said she completed a residency in obstetrics and gynecology and joined a practice specializing in high-risk obstetrics, where she became a full business partner.
After 23 years practicing medicine, she said, she bought a farm in Palermo with her husband, where they raise sheep, laying hens and pigs.
Swift has been affiliated with the Palermo Community Library, Branch Mills Grange #336 and the Palermo Historical Society.
In the 2022 survey she said she was serving her second term on the Palermo Select Board.
She lost the Maine House District 62 general election to Katrina Smith in 2022 and again in 2024, and won the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.
In the 2022 survey, Swift listed health care, agriculture and the environment as her key issues, including health insurance coverage for all, small family farms and PFAS contamination.
